Battleship.name: Battleship
Battleship.summary:
Take command of a U.S. Naval fleet to wage war against an unknown alien force. Secure the seas, before it's too late.

The Wii/DS/3DS versions feature a turn based strategy gameplay approach not found in the PS3/X360 version.

Boom Street.name: Fortune Street
Boom Street.summary: Get on board, corner the market & make a fortune! Players become familiar characters from the Nintendo and Dragon Quest universes in a board game that challenges them to play the real estate and stock markets wisely to win. Players race around the board trying to accumulate wealth and hit a target value while buying, selling and trading property with friends and family to see who can be the first to cash out. What appears at first to be a simple property-buying board game offers multiple levels of money-maximizing opportunity.

Hip Hop Dance Experience, The.name: The Hip Hop Dance Experience
Hip Hop Dance Experience, The.summary: The Hip Hop Dance Experience is a dancing game for the Wii and Xbox 360 published by Ubisoft. It is a continuation of The Experience franchise, a spin-off of the Just Dance series.

Tale of Despereaux, The.name: The Tale of Despereaux
Tale of Despereaux, The.summary:
Small Mouse. Big Dreams.
In this epic adventure, play as the courageous mouse Despereaux on a heroic quest to save the Princess Pea. Discover a magical world in this tale of bravery where the tiniest mouse finds the courage of knight in shining armor.
